svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print two in PETG, lying on a 190 x 50 mm face: 190 long, 25 wide,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 50 tall. Every part fits a 200 x 200 mm bed.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two 6.6 mm holes top to bottom, 50 mm each side of the centre (100

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: apart, on the threaded 50 mm sub-grid).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Counterbore each 11 mm from the top down to 12 mm above the base,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: so an M6 x 30 cap screw reaches the thread below the worktop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: two M6 x 30 cap screws into threaded grid positions; the two

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: segments stand end to end with a 10 mm gap.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the front face is square to the base (engineer's square).
